t: On going harder than you can sustain
a: إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِ، فَاكْلَفُوا مِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ
m: Do not practise continuous fasting. They said: but you do. He said: I am not like you. I spend the night and my Lord feeds me and gives me drink. So take on of deeds what you can bear.
